objects.constraint public.audit_events.audit_eve:
CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (action = 'membership.role_changed'::text) THEN ((details - ARRAY['oldRole'::text, 'newRole'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb)
    WHEN (action = ANY (ARRAY['api_key.created'::text, 'api_key.rotated'::text])) THEN ((details - 'scope'::text) = '{}'::jsonb)
    WHEN (action = ANY (ARRAY['webhook.created'::text, 'webhook.updated'::text, 'webhook.deleted'::text, 'webhook.secret_rotated'::text, 'webhook.paused'::text, 'webhook.resumed'::text])) THEN ((details - 'events'::text) = '{}'::jsonb)
    WHEN (action = 'oauth.token_revoked'::text) THEN ((details - 'familySize'::text) = '{}'::jsonb)
    WHEN (action = 'organization.branding_updated'::text) THEN (((details - ARRAY['logo'::text, 'primaryColor'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (details <> '{}'::jsonb) AND ((NOT (details ? 'logo'::text)) OR COALESCE(((details ->> 'logo'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['uploaded'::text, 'selected'::text, 'removed'::text])), false)) AND ((NOT (details ? 'primaryColor'::text)) OR COALESCE(((details ->> 'primaryColor'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['set'::text, 'cleared'::text])), false)))
    WHEN (action = 'booking.attendee_no_show_changed'::text) THEN (((details - ARRAY['attendeeId'::text, 'noShow'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((details -> 'attendeeId'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((details ->> 'attendeeId'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text)), false) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((details -> 'noShow'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((details ->> 'noShow'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['marked'::text, 'unmarked'::text]))), false))
    ELSE (details = '{}'::jsonb)
END))
